defects.title: no quote exists after the answer
defects.green: quote_at/schedule reserve the first bar open at or after received_at_ms

defects.title: executable price synthesized from OHLC
defects.green: execution.quote_at raises InsufficientResolution for any instant strictly inside a bar

defects.title: entry bar never checked against its stop
defects.green: entries run first, then the bar range is examined; exit stamped at the bar close

defects.title: a gap through the stop fills at the stop level
defects.green: PaperBroker.check_positions_ohlc(gap_policy="open_on_gap") fills at the open; legacy default unchanged

defects.green: summary.reconciliation with five identities, plus an independent re-derivation in the verifier

superseded_expectations.now: fills at the first quote after the answer; no fill may predate it
superseded_expectations.why: the zero was the symptom of B-01, not a property to preserve

superseded_expectations.was: STALE_EXECUTION drop when the next bar was missing
superseded_expectations.now: the fill waits for the first quote after the answer and declares its lag; a hole wider than the opinion window still expires
superseded_expectations.why: an index rule cannot tell a data hole from real latency, and it rejected every real answer

paper_runs.identical_to_vis_note: the mock script ignores the prompt, so identical trades are expected and are not evidence of parity between the agents

known_non_determinism: each ledger line records recorded_at_utc, so two runs of the same data differ in that field and therefore in the chain hash
summary.run_id is a fresh uuid per run
everything else in the ledger and the summary is identical across roots and runs
limitations: the provider is a deterministic mock; model_status is MOCK_TEST and no multimodal call was made
both bots produce the same trades because the script ignores the prompt: this run proves execution plumbing, not agent skill
historical replay is not prospective evidence and cannot be labelled as such
the full repository test suite was not executed; 171 unrelated files were already modified by other work and were not touched
the cost of a 900 ms round trip is one full bar of delay on a 1h grid: that is the resolution limit, not a bug
